```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(JBrowseR)
out_dir <- getwd()
data_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "data")
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Copy all required files into local bundle
file.copy(params$fasta, data_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(paste0(params$fasta, ".fai"), data_dir, overwrite = TRUE)

file.copy(params$bam, data_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(paste0(params$bam, ".bai"), data_dir, overwrite = TRUE)


```


```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
asm <- assembly("data/expandedgenomeregions.fa")
bam_track <- track_alignments(
  track_data = "data/minimaptrial.sorted.bam",
  assembly = asm
)

dark_theme <- theme(
  primary = "#000000",
  secondary = "#0097a7",
  tertiary = "#f57c00",
  quaternary = "#d50000"
)

JBrowseR(
  view = "View",
  assembly = asm,
  tracks = tracks(bam_track),
  location = "CM042145.1:1..10000",
  theme = dark_theme

)
```
